title: feat(sdk): list video, audio and embedding models with models(kind)
author: Saauf

gist.summary: The SDK's `models()` and `getModels()` now accept an optional kind: `text`, `image`, `video`, `audio`, or `embeddings`. Passing a kind fetches `/<kind>/models`; omitting it still fetches `/models`. Existing `textModels()` and `imageModels()` methods remain for compatibility. The SDK README and changelog document the change, and tests cover endpoint routing.
